items.headline: [P] TurboQuant for weights: near‑optimal 4‑bit LLM quantization with lossless 8‑bit residual – 3.2× memory savings
items.summary: An adaptation of the recent TurboQuant algorithm (Zandieh et al., 2025) from KV‑cache quantization to model weight compression. It gives you a drop‑in replacement for nn.Linear with near‑optimal distortion. items.headline: Do not use mixed KV cache quantization
items.summary: I've seen a few people in the comments on here and the other AI subs suggest mixing quantization for the KV cache to retain higher accuracy and still saving memory. I was running that for a while until I realized how wrong it is.
